evals.name: part-and-mass
evals.prompt: Model a 40 x 20 x 10 mm block in FormCAD and tell me its volume.
expected_behavior: Uses template part, cmd_partsketch, cmd_partsketchdone, cmd_featextrude, cmd_bodymass
Reads feature state after each step

evals.name: refused-path
expected_behavior: Hits the granted-folder refusal, reports it
Asks the user to grant the folder, does not edit automation.json itself

evals.name: drawing-views
evals.prompt: Make a three view drawing of my part.
expected_behavior: Opens the part, passes layout Layout1 to cmd_viewbase, adds projected and section views
Exports a PDF inside a granted folder, no source.doc

trigger_evals.query: model a bracket in formcad and export a pdf
connect claude to the formcad mcp server
run a .graph file headless in formcad
make a sheet metal flat pattern dxf in formcad
install formcad and run its doctor
add a router to the formcad backend
draw a part in some other cad program
write a python script to parse dxf
